01 / PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Engineering judgement,
grounded in site execution.

A project-facing portfolio for employers, clients, collaborators and delivery partners.

Civil Engineer with over four years of progressive experience across structural design support, building and infrastructure construction, and site management. Practical experience spans residential developments, multi-storey reinforced-concrete works, foundation activities, retaining walls, indoor sports facilities, adaptive reuse and finishing delivery.

I work at the point where drawings, materials, trades and site conditions meet: coordinating people and resources, monitoring workmanship, identifying constraints early, recording progress and escalating decisions that require specialist approval.
